L06B059.q: Ravi walks 10 km north, then 3 km west, then 6 km south. How far is Ravi from the starting point (km)?
L06B059.e: Net: 4 km north and 3 km west. Distance = √(4² + 3²) = 5 km.

L07B001.e: 7 + 6 = 13 parts, one part = 6. Pooja gets 7 parts = ₹42.

L07B009.q: A shopkeeper buys a lamp for ₹200 and sells it for ₹280. What is the profit percent?
L07B009.e: Profit = ₹80. Profit % is on the cost price: 80 ÷ 200 × 100 = 40%.

L07B010.q: The 27th of a month is a Wednesday. What day of the week is the 3rd of the same month?
L07B010.e: Going back 24 days is 3 whole weeks and 3 more, so Sunday.

L07B011.q: Four friends - Arjun, Meera, Ravi and Tara - sit in a row (left and right as you look at them). Arjun does not sit next to Tara. Ravi sits immediately to the left of Tara. Arjun does not sit next to Ravi. Meera sits somewhere to the left of Tara. Who sits second from the left?
L07B011.e: Only one order fits every clue: Arjun, Meera, Ravi, Tara (left to right). So the answer is Meera.

L07B012.q: Four friends - Aman, Asha, Isha and Kabir - sit in a row (left and right as you look at them). Isha sits at one of the two ends. Aman does not sit next to Kabir. Kabir sits at one of the two ends. Asha sits immediately to the left of Aman. Who sits at the far left?
L07B012.e: Only one order fits every clue: Kabir, Asha, Aman, Isha (left to right). So the answer is Kabir.

L07B013.q: Four friends - Asha, Kabir, Ravi and Riya - sit in a row (left and right as you look at them). Exactly 1 person sits between Asha and Kabir. Kabir sits immediately to the left of Ravi. Asha does not sit at either end. Who sits second from the left?
L07B013.e: Only one order fits every clue: Kabir, Ravi, Asha, Riya (left to right). So the answer is Ravi.

a natural emotion - what matters is how you respond
a sign you are a bad person

M01Q003.q: Before reacting in anger, the most helpful first step is to…
M01Q003.e: A pause creates choice. Slow breaths first, then respond.
o: say everything you feel at once
walk away and never discuss it
pause and take a slow breath

M01Q004.q: Which of these is naming your emotion?
M01Q004.e: Naming the feeling - hurt, ignored - is the first step of emotional awareness.
o: I feel hurt and a little ignored right now.

M01Q005.e: Rest is not giving up. It's how you restore yourself.

M01Q006.e: Saying no doesn't make you selfish. Aapka “nahi” bhi ek mindful decision hai.
o: you are including yourself in the care you give everyone else

M01Q007.q: Someone hasn't replied to your message for a few hours. The calmest thought is…
M01Q007.e: Not every silence is rejection. Give people space - and give yourself peace.
o: I'll keep messaging until they reply.
They must be angry with me.
They might be busy - I'll give them space.

M01Q008.e: Self-compassion is speaking to yourself the way you would to a dear friend.
o: Others have it worse, so I can't feel bad.
I did the best I could with what I knew then.
I should have known better, I'm so stupid.

M01Q009.e: Strong rehna achha hai, lekin har waqt strong rehna zaroori nahi hai.

M01Q010.e: A boundary is not a punishment. It tells people how to love you well.
o: a doorway that tells people how to love you well

M01Q011.e: The goal is emotional awareness, not emotional suppression.
o: noticing and understanding what you feel

M01Q012.q: Feeling irritated while managing home and office every day may mean…
M01Q012.e: Irritation is often a sign of exhaustion - a signal to ask for support, not to push harder.
o: you may be emotionally exhausted and need support

M02Q001.q: You keep saying “no” but still accept the same behaviour. What usually happens?
M02Q001.e: Your “no” becomes powerful when your actions support it.
o: The other person may never understand your boundary is real

M02Q002.q: A healthy way to express hurt is…
M02Q002.e: Express hurt calmly, instead of going silent or exploding.
o: saying calmly, “I felt hurt when this happened”

M02Q003.q: Your honest words upset a friend. Whose job is it to manage their feelings?
M02Q003.e: Say the true thing kindly, then let it land where it lands.
o: Theirs - your job is to say it kindly

M02Q004.q: Which is a sign you may be someone's backup plan?
M02Q004.e: Look at patterns, not promises. If you are always adjusting, you are carrying it alone.
o: You are always the one adjusting and waiting

M02Q005.q: Leaving a relationship that keeps hurting you is…
M02Q005.e: Leaving is not failing. Staying is not loyalty.

M02Q006.q: Some people come into our lives as…
M02Q006.e: Har rishta nibhane ke liye nahi hota. Kuch sirf kuch sikhane ke liye aate hain.

M02Q007.q: If someone does not respect you, the healthiest step is to…
M02Q007.e: You can't make someone respect you. Choose yourself, and protect your peace.
o: set boundaries and protect your peace

M02Q008.e: Don't fill silence with assumptions - ask calmly if it matters.
o: can mean tiredness, stress or needing space

M02Q009.q: Starting with “I feel…” instead of “You always…” helps because it…
M02Q009.e: “I” statements open a conversation; “you always” starts a fight.

M02Q010.e: Missing someone is not a reason to go back.
o: not, by itself, a reason to go back

M02Q011.q: Loneliness can make an old situation look…
M02Q011.e: Loneliness will make an old situation look softer than it was.

M02Q012.q: To ask for what you need in a relationship, start with…
M02Q012.e: One calm sentence, without a long explanation, is enough.

M03Q001.e: Limiting beliefs are learned - so they can be questioned and changed.
o: an old idea that quietly decides what you think you are allowed to do
a fact about who you are

M03Q002.q: The rules you agreed to when you knew less…
M03Q002.e: You are allowed to change the rules. You know more now; you can choose again.
o: can be changed - you know more now

M03Q003.q: Change often feels like ___ before it feels like freedom.
M03Q003.e: Change can feel like loss before it feels like freedom.

M03Q004.q: “Why me?” keeps you stuck. Which question moves you forward?
M03Q004.e: Shift the question, shift your perspective, shift your next step.

M03Q005.e: Healing is learning when it's safe to let go.
o: learning when it's safe to let go of old protection

M03Q006.e: You are not the worst thing that was done to you.
o: part of your story, not the definition of you

M03Q007.e: Progress is not the absence of the wound. It is a shorter walk home.

M03Q008.q: Waiting to feel completely certain before acting often…
M03Q008.e: Waiting to feel certain is how good lives stay in the drafts folder.
o: keeps good plans stuck in the drafts folder

M03Q009.q: The version of you that you want is built…
M03Q009.e: It is not built in one dramatic weekend - it is built in unremarkable, repeated days.

M03Q010.e: You can hold both without apologising for either.
o: able to live together without apology

M03Q011.q: You cannot heal in an environment that…
M03Q011.e: You cannot heal in the same environment that keeps reopening the wound.

M03Q012.q: Stop shrinking to fit rooms you have…
M03Q012.e: Stop shrinking to fit rooms you have already outgrown.

M04Q001.q: Your teenage child ignores your reminders to study. Which response protects the relationship?
M04Q001.e: Pause, find the real concern, and communicate without insults or threats.
o: “I care about your studies. Let's make a realistic timetable together.”

M04Q002.q: A relative keeps calling you at midnight. A clear boundary sounds like…
M04Q002.e: One calm sentence, then act on it the same way every time.
o: “I can't take calls after 9 pm - let's talk in the morning.”

M04Q003.q: You compare yourself with a friend's “perfect” Instagram life and feel low. A helpful thought is…
M04Q003.e: Comparison measures your inside against someone else's outside.
o: Social media shows highlights - my journey is my own.

M04Q004.q: A colleague takes credit for your idea. The most effective first step is to…
M04Q004.e: Respond, don't react: calm, direct and specific.
o: speak to them calmly and state what happened

M04Q005.q: You said yes to too many things and now feel resentful. Next time you can…
M04Q005.e: A pause before “yes” protects both your energy and your relationships.
o: cancel everything at the last minute
pause before agreeing and check your time and energy

M04Q006.q: Your partner forgets a date that matters to you. Which response builds the relationship?
M04Q006.e: Say what you felt and why it matters - without attacking.
o: “I felt hurt it was forgotten - it matters to me.”

M04Q007.q: After a setback, the most useful thing to do within 24 hours is…
M04Q007.e: Small, doable actions rebuild a sense of control faster than waiting to feel ready.
o: one small action that moves you forward

M04Q008.q: You catch yourself thinking, “Main sabke liye kar rahi hoon - but mere liye kaun?” A healthy response is to…
M04Q008.e: Apne liye time nikalna bhi self-respect hai.
o: make a little time for yourself - that is self-respect too

M04Q009.q: Someone calls your boundary “selfish”. The best response is to…
M04Q009.e: Some people get upset at first, especially those who benefited from you having none.
o: stay kind and consistent - their discomfort doesn't make you wrong

M04Q010.q: You feel a strong emotion but can't name it. A good first step is to…
M04Q010.e: Your body often notices before your mind does. Start there.
o: notice where you feel it in your body and breathe

M04Q011.q: A friend shares her worries with you. Listening well means…
M04Q011.e: Listen to understand, not just to reply.
o: changing the topic to your problems
planning your reply while she talks
listening to understand, and asking a question

M04Q012.q: Every morning you check everyone's messages before anything else. A mindful change could be…
M04Q012.e: Start the day answering to yourself before you answer to anyone else.
o: pausing to check in with yourself before your phone

M05Q001.q: Coaching is different from therapy because coaching…
M05Q001.e: Coaching focuses on what is happening now and what you can do differently.
o: works on your present patterns and what you can do next

M05Q002.q: When might coaching NOT be the right help?
M05Q002.e: Har problem ka solution coaching nahi hota - aur sahi help lena weakness nahi, wisdom hai.
o: When clinical or therapeutic support is needed
When you want to set goals

M05Q003.q: Fear can protect you from getting hurt - and it can also…
M05Q003.e: You don't have to keep carrying the armor that once helped you survive.
o: protect you from being truly alive

M05Q004.q: A self-respecting response to repeated disrespect is…
M05Q004.e: Set boundaries. Protect your peace. Know your worth.
o: knowing your worth and protecting your peace

M05Q005.q: Most stuck decisions are not unclear. They are…
M05Q005.e: Often you already know - the hard part is the cost of choosing.

M05Q006.q: Keeping everyone comfortable by disappearing yourself is…
M05Q006.e: Disappearing to keep the peace is not harmony. It is a quiet form of absence.

M05Q007.q: Effort is not always the missing ingredient. Sometimes…
M05Q007.e: Some things don't grow because of where they are planted, not how hard you try.

M05Q008.q: You keep trying to guarantee an outcome. The truth is…
M05Q008.e: You keep trying to guarantee the outcome. That was never on offer.
o: a guarantee was never on offer - you choose your effort and response

M05Q009.e: In healthy love you don't have to audition for your place.
o: safety, respect and being able to be yourself
having to prove yourself every day

M05Q010.e: Healthy doesn't mean perfect - it means repair is possible.

M05Q011.q: Being proud of the woman who kept going is…
M05Q011.e: Aapne sirf survive nahi kiya - aapne khud ko sambhala, seekha aur grow kiya.
o: giving yourself the credit you deserve

M05Q012.q: “Jab aap khud ko samajhne lagti hain…”
M05Q012.e: Understanding yourself changes how you respond - and that changes everything around it.
o: you start responding to life differently
